description: This file contains implementation of utility functions and data structures related to computing differences between text files, such as square root approximation, diff output emission, file memory management, line estimation, line comparison, and hash functions, part of the LibXDiff library.

methods.name: long xdl_bogosqrt(long n)
methods.description: Approximate integer square root using bit shifts.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_diffrec(char const * rec,long size,char const * pre,long psize,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emit diff record with optional newline message.

methods.name: void * xdl_mmfile_first(mmfile_t * mmf,long * size)
methods.description: Return pointer to the first character of mmfile data and set size.

methods.name: long xdl_mmfile_size(mmfile_t * mmf)
methods.description: Return size of the mmfile data.

methods.name: int xdl_cha_init(chastore_t * cha,long isize,long icount)
methods.description: Initialize a chase buffer with specified element size and count.

methods.name: void xdl_cha_free(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Free all nodes in a chase buffer.

methods.name: void * xdl_cha_alloc(chastore_t * cha)
methods.description: Allocate a new element in chase buffer, expanding storage if necessary.

methods.name: long xdl_guess_lines(mmfile_t * mf,long sample)
methods.description: Estimate number of lines in a file based on sampled data.

methods.name: int xdl_blankline(const char * line,long size,long flags)
methods.description: Check if a line consists only of whitespace, considering flags.

methods.name: int xdl_recmatch(const char * l1,long s1,const char * l2,long s2,long flags)
methods.description: Compare two lines with various whitespace ignoring options.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_with_whitespace(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top,uint64_t flags)
methods.description: Hash a record while considering whitespace normalization options.

methods.name: uint64_t xdl_hash_record_verbatim(uint8_t const ** data,uint8_t const * top)
methods.description: Hash a record exactly as-is, processing two characters at a time.

methods.name: int xdl_num_out(char * out,long val)
methods.description: Convert a number to its decimal string representation.

methods.name: int xdl_format_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Format a diff hunk header line.

methods.name: int xdl_emit_hunk_hdr(long s1,long c1,long s2,long c2,const char * func,long funclen,xdemitcb_t * ecb)
methods.description: Emit a diff hunk header, either formatted or via callback.

methods.name: int xdl_fall_back_diff(xdfenv_t * diff_env,xpparam_t const * xpp,int line1,int count1,int line2,int count2)
methods.description: Perform fallback diff on file segments using provided environment.

methods.name: void * xdl_alloc_grow_helper(void * p,long nr,long * alloc,size_t size)
methods.description: Helper to grow array with reallocation, handling size limits.

methods.name: int ends_with_optional_cr(const char * l,long s,long i)
